subject: Lockdown call to ink & onboarding onramp — timing, approvers, and paperflow
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@nebularetail.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc:

Subject: Lockdown call to ink & onboarding onramp — timing, approvers, and paperflow

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation. Attached is the MAP_Nebula_v3.pdf and the SOW_Nebula_draft.docx (short attachment stubs below).

High level ask: we want to lock the final sign-off timeline this week so Legal/Procurement can route signatures and we can provision the dedicated capacity in time for your planned onramp. Proposed milestones:
- Lock MAP & price appendix by Wednesday 10/6
- DocuSign sent by Thursday 10/7
- Signatures by Tuesday 10/12 (ideally)
- Canary onramp window: 10/18–10/24
- Production start target: 10/25 (flexible based on training ops)

Can we schedule a 30-min "lockdown" call on Monday 10/4 at 11:00 AM PT to confirm approvers and signers? Please confirm who will be the authorized signer(s) on your side and whether procurement needs any additional paperwork (NDA addendum / tax form).

Attachments: MAP_Nebula_v3.pdf (pdf), SOW_Nebula_draft.docx (docx)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Legal once we confirm signers.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-02T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lockdown call to ink & onboarding onramp — timing, approvers, and paperflow

Camila —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Procurement and Legal started a quick pass this morning. Two notes:
1) We need a final price appendix (line items + committed QPS) attached to the SOW — procurement asked for a price_appendix_vFINAL.xlsx.
2) Our earliest practical canary window is 10/18, but our internal ops team has asked if production could shift to 10/31 to allow a two-week stabilization period after canary. Is that workable on your side?

Tom Haines (cc'd) will be our signer for the contract (VP Ops). He asked that the DocuSign envelope include the SOW and the MAP as separate documents.

We can do the Monday 10/4 11:00 AM PT call — Tom will join.

— Elena

Thanks team — confirming a few things before Monday's call (10/4, 11:00 AM PT):
Action items (owners)
- Camila: Finalize DocuSign envelope and include MAP + SOW as separate docs; send today if Legal greenlights. (Done once Priyom confirms)
- Priyom: Quick legal pass on SOW + any SLA language that could block procurement (target: EOD 10/5).
- Rafael: Confirm price appendix numbers and attach to DocuSign (done).
- Elena / Tom: Confirm authorized signer (Tom confirmed) and any PO/contract routing requirements.

On start dates: 10/18 canary is fine. We are flexible on production: if Nebula prefers 10/31 for broader rollout, Redwood can accommodate but we will need a firm freeze on config changes by 10/25 to meet that production date. Please confirm which production window you prefer on the call.

DocuSign: I will prepare the envelope and share the link in the lockdown call; if Legal approves by EOD 10/5 we can send the envelope 10/6 and aim for signatures by 10/12. If signatures come in later, Rafael's note on capacity still applies.

On the call we will also cover: signer order, billing start date (aligns to signature date), and any required tax forms.

— Camila
